name: fieldgate
title: Fieldgate
description: A land agent's sale plan on map-sheet white: every listing is a lot, a field parcel washed rose, straw, sky or sage and edged in red, with its name in old-style italic and its area lettered largest in a plain box at the centre; pending and taken lots carry a hatched band.

tokens.--font-serif: old-style serif: italic titles, spaced upright capitals
tokens.--color-paper: plan sheet, lettering boxes, unsold plan fields, inquiry box
tokens.--color-text: engraver's black: body text, headings, lot lettering
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: standfirsts, place names, facts, hours, dates
tokens.--color-accent: sale-plan red: lot edging, links, current menu item, pending statuses
tokens.--color-line: engraved line: box edges, neat lines, plan boundaries, rules
tokens.--color-rule: light rules: table rows, inquiry heading, code edge, menu hover
tokens.--color-wash-rose: lot 1 of four, the home plan's middle lot; listing pages by slug (the rest)
tokens.--color-wash-straw: lot 2 of four, a home plan field; listing pages by slug (b f j n r v z)
tokens.--color-wash-sky: lot 3 of four, home plan fields and beck; listing pages by slug (c g k o s w)
tokens.--color-wash-sage: lot 4 of four, a home plan field; listing pages by slug (d h l p t x)
tokens.--color-hatch-pending: hatching on a pending lot and on the home plan
tokens.--text-s: small text: facts, hours, the footer
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts, the price on a listing's page
tokens.--text-figure: a lot's area (or price), its largest lettering
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a reading column
tokens.--lot-min: narrowest lot before the plan drops a column
tokens.--edge: red edging of a lot; quote and code rules
tokens.--space-1: smallest spacing step; a parcel's inset in its cell
